query:
FROM logs-zeek.ssh-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:51:42Z" AND @timestamp <= "2026-07-26T20:21:42Z"
  AND (
    (source.ip == "172.18.0.12")
    OR
    (source.ip == "172.18.0.6" AND destination.ip == "172.18.0.12")
  )
| STATS count = COUNT(*), first_ts = MIN(@timestamp), last_ts = MAX(@timestamp),
        auth_successes = COUNT(zeek.ssh.auth.success == true),
        auth_failures = COUNT(zeek.ssh.auth.success == false),
        auth_nulls = COUNT(zeek.ssh.auth.success IS NULL)
    BY source.ip, destination.ip, zeek.ssh.client, zeek.ssh.server
| SORT count DESC
